title: Transport of ordinary base change and its second mate across a source scheme isomorphism
statement: Let P,U,S,T be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, f:P→S and f′:U→S be qcqs morphisms, e:U≅P satisfy e.hom followed by f equals f′, and g:T→S be any morphism. Choose right adjoints a,b,d,b′ with adjunctions to the canonical lifted direct images of f,f′, pullback(f,g)→T and pullback(f′,g)→T, respectively. Suppose ordinary base change for f′ along g is invertible on every object of D_QCoh(U). Fix K in D_QCoh(S). Let r:pullback(f′,g)→pullback(f,g) satisfy r followed by the projection to P equals the projection to U followed by e.hom, and r followed by the projection to T equals the projection to T. Then ordinary base change for f along g is invertible on every object of D_QCoh(P). For every proof of that invertibility, the ambient second mate for f at K pulled back along r is isomorphic in the arrow category to the ambient second mate for f′ at K. No invertibility of these second mates is assumed. Schemes, fibre products, derived categories, pullback, direct image, the canonical lifted qcqs direct image, ordinary base change and the fixed second mate are as in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint, def-pc-derived-base-change-map, def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map].

source.place: Tag 0ATR, composite adjunction and conjugate comparison calculation; Tag 0E9S, identification with the cartesian restriction model, isolated from the successive-square pasting step

proof.text: The projection equations make r the base change of e.hom, with inverse induced by e.inv. The pullback composition and identity comparisons make pullback along e and r equivalences of derived categories; preservation of quasi-coherent cohomology restricts these equivalences to D_QCoh.

Direct-image composition along e and r identifies the vertical direct-image functors after this transport. Transport the specified adjunctions, and apply right-adjoint uniqueness with its unit and counit identities to obtain comparisons for a,b and d,b′.

Transpose ordinary base change under the selected pullback/direct-image adjunction. The two projection equations and pullback associativity identify the transposes. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence gives the commutative comparison square. Its vertical maps are isomorphisms; the equivalence on objects and the assumed invertibility for f′ therefore imply invertibility for f.

Expand the fixed second-mate formula. Move its units and counits across the comparisons using the transported adjunction identities; conjugation respects the ordinary comparison and its inverse. The resulting commutative square has the preceding endpoint isomorphisms, so Arrow.isoMk gives the arrow isomorphism. This never inverts a second mate.

theorem rightAdjoint_mate_scheme_iso_transport
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {P U S T : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace P] [QuasiSeparatedSpace P] [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (f : P ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (f' : U ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f'] [QuasiSeparated f']
    (e : U ≅ P) (he : e.hom ≫ f = f') (g : T ⟶ S)
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory P)
    (b : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory U)
    (d : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (b' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f' g))
    (adja : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty S).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty P).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
        f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjb : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty S).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty U).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f')
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f') _ _ _ _
        f' _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ b)
    (adjd : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ d)
    (adjb' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f' g)).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f' g))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f' g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f' g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ b')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory U,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f' (pullback.snd f' g) g
        (pullback.fst f' g) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S)
    (r : pullback f' g ⟶ pullback f g)
    (hr₁ : r ≫ pullback.fst f g = pullback.fst f' g ≫ e.hom)
    (hr₂ : r ≫ pullback.snd f g = pullback.snd f' g) :
    (∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory P,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj)) ∧
    (∀ hβf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory P,
        IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
          (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj),
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback r).map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι.map
      (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f g a d adja adjd hβf K))) ≅
        Arrow.mk ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f' g)).ι.map
      (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f' g b b' adjb adjb' hβ K))))
